## What is new

- Built with Go 1.27.3. It carries the Go security fix to `crypto/x509` released on 2026-10-19 (CVE-2026-111943): certificate verification now rejects chains through a small set of distrusted intermediate certificates, so the HTTPS connections Archivist makes no longer trust certificates issued under them. It also carries the Go 1.27.2 security fixes to `crypto/tls`, `net/http`, `net/textproto` and `os`.
- Windows: Archivist now installs in `.archivist\bin` in your user folder instead of AppData. Before it uses your pairing code, the install checks that Windows can start Archivist, so a command run inside a packaged app such as the Claude desktop app stops with a clear message and your code stays unused.
- When background connect cannot start, the message now names the Task Scheduler result (for example "file not found") and, on a paired computer, tells you to run the install command again without a new code.
- Pairing (`archivist connect --pair`, and the install command with a code) no longer asks a question in the terminal. Every pairing is confirmed with one Confirm click on a Mosaic page that shows the account and the computer name. The page opens in your browser, and the link is printed too, so a computer without a browser can be confirmed from any device signed in to your account.
- Commands and flags are unchanged.

## Updating

From v0.2.35 on macOS and Linux, run `archivist update` (Homebrew: `brew upgrade mosaic-finance-inc/tap/archivist`).

On Windows, run the install command below again in a normal PowerShell window: it moves Archivist out of AppData and updates it.

From v0.2.34 or older, run the install command again. Do not use `archivist update` for this update.

macOS and Linux:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://github.com/mosaicss/archivist/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash
```

Windows (PowerShell):

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://github.com/mosaicss/archivist/releases/latest/download/install.ps1)))
```

If you run `archivist connect` in a terminal window, start it again after updating.
